'''Delta-622-Echo''' was an encrypted communications channel in use during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] used it after she was shot down on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Cavamina Minor]].

==Behind the scenes==
This code appears in the [[2010]] graphic novella ''[[The Clone Wars: Deadly Hands of Shon-Ju]]''.
